title: Helpful answers, connected to the order
summary: A customer-service concept that brings order information into the conversation and routes unusual requests to the team.
challenge: Customers repeatedly ask about products, delivery, and returns. Staff switch between messages and order records to find an answer, while more complex requests wait in the same queue.
approach: Connect eligible support channels to approved product information and authorised order data. Automate routine answers within agreed rules, collect missing details, and hand unusual or sensitive requests to a person.
outcome: The proposed journey helps customers find the next step while giving the team the context needed to help. It illustrates a possible solution, with no claim of a live integration or measured support improvement.
